processing.operation: Full sources resized to 256x256 with Lanczos; 128px edge-extruded gutters per 512px quadrant
processing.sampling: Clamp UVs to safe rectangles (span 255/1024); quadrant-isolated bilinear taps through mip 8 with aligned 2x2 box mip generation; trilinear safe only when both sampled levels are <=8. Coarser mips are subpixel for the 256px content region and may mix quadrants; wider/anisotropic filters are not covered
processing.uv_convention: [u_min, v_min, u_max, v_max], texel centers; origin top-left, u right, v down
